queries:
WITH event_avg AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM budget
),
above AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_event, e.avg_amount, o.overall_avg
    FROM event_avg e
    CROSS JOIN overall o
    WHERE e.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_amount,
    avg_amount - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
    avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS diff_from_above_mean
FROM above
ORDER BY diff_from_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM ev
),
above AS (
    SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS beat_overall
    FROM ev, overall
    WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       beat_overall,
       avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS gap_from_above_mean
FROM above
ORDER BY gap_from_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(COALESCE(amount, 0)) AS overall_avg
    FROM budget
),
above AS (
    SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall
    FROM per_event p, overall o
    WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_amount,
    diff_from_overall,
    avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS diff_from_above_mean
FROM above
ORDER BY diff_from_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
above AS (
    SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount
    FROM ev, overall
    WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg
),
above_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS mean_above
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
      AND link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM above)
)
SELECT
    above.link_to_event,
    above.avg_amount,
    above.avg_amount - overall.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg,
    above.avg_amount - above_mean.mean_above AS diff_from_above_mean
FROM above, overall, above_mean
ORDER BY diff_from_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
